en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a full-length portrait of a bearded man dressed in traditional dervish attire, including a turban and long robes. He stands outdoors on rocky ground, holding a long staff in his right hand and a bag or satchel slung across his shoulder. The background is a stylized cloudy sky. At the bottom of the image, printed text identifies the scene as related to Salonique and a dervish Bektash.
